summary: RFC 8955 requires the originator of a BGP Flow Specification to match the originator of the best-match unicast route for the destination prefix, which limits where it can be originated. This document updates that validation so a Flow Specification can be originated from anywhere within the autonomous system, for example by a centralized controller.

eli5.summary: A rule about who can post traffic filters was too strict. This document loosens it so a central helper inside the same network can post them too.
